Rocket Lab is explicitly listed in primary_contractors for the Tracking Layer (FUNDED_STEADY) but NOT for the Transport Layer (UNFUNDED).
Cohort metadata: 'SDA Tracking Layer T3 prime exposure' confirms the company's actual exposure is to the FUNDED sub-layer.
scores.M_value: Tracking Layer = FUNDED_STEADY; Transport Layer = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (RKLB not contracted on Transport)
scores.interpretation: pentagon_jbook fired and resolved the apparent ambiguity in the company's favor: their actual contracted role is on the funded Tracking sub-line, not the zeroed Transport sub-line. PASS. However, this is the kind of disclosure that should be flagged for investor-clarity: the filing language 'SDA Tranche 3' is materially imprecise because the same PE houses one funded and one zeroed line. NOTE coverage-gap to add precision in future disclosures.

scores.claim_text: Continue to expand into new launch service verticals, such as Hypersonic Accelerator Suborbital Test Electron (HASTE).
supports: PE 0604033F (Hypersonics Prototyping, USAF RDT&E) shows status UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS: $27.9M in FY24, $0 in FY25 and FY26. This was the flagship Air Force hypersonics RDT&E line.

Companion PE 0604183F (Hypersonics Prototyping - HACM) is FUNDED_GROWING: $333M FY24 → $467M FY25 → $803M FY26. So the funding has consolidated into HACM specifically, not the broader prototyping line.
HASTE is a derived suborbital testbed; the relevant procurement vehicles (e.g., MACH-TB, EWAAC) are not in the J-Book corpus. usaspending shows only $1,000 obligated under EWAAC on-ramp to RKLB.
scores.interpretation: Mixed signal. The forward hypersonic test cadence the company is positioning toward is real (HACM is growing), but the broader prototyping budget line (where HASTE rides) is zeroed. Forward narrative is load-bearing on a market that has consolidated to a single program (HACM) where RKLB is not a named prime. MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY.

scores.claim_text: Photon spacecraft positioned to fly as secondary payload on NSSL rockets of the U.S. Space Force.

However, this RDT&E line is NOT where production launches are funded; NSSL Phase 3 procurement happens through P-40 / O&M / Procurement appropriations not in this PE.
usaspending.query_dod_contracts returns NSSL Phase 3 Lane 1 award $5,000,000 to 'ROCKET LAB NATIONAL SECURITY LLC' (FA881125FB007) — RKLB has actually won an NSSL Phase 3 Lane 1 contract.
scores.M_value: RDT&E PE FUNDED_SHRINKING (expected for EMD-end); production NSSL contract booked
scores.interpretation: The RDT&E line shrinkage is structural (program transitioned to production), not a divergence signal. RKLB has a real NSSL Phase 3 Lane 1 award. Forward positioning is supported. PASS.

_summary.headline: Pentagon J-Book disambiguated RKLB's SDA Tranche 3 exposure as Tracking Layer (FUNDED_STEADY) not Transport Layer (UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS, replaced by SpaceX Starshield). STP-S30 ($14.5M) and NSSL Phase 3 Lane 1 ($5M) procurement confirmed via USAspending. Hypersonics flagship RDT&E PE 0604033F is zeroed but companion HACM PE 0604183F is funded-growing; HASTE is positioned for a market that has consolidated to a specific program where RKLB is not a named prime — single MODERATE flag.
